tier_reason: The only speed statement is a mid-2000s package-description sentence ('seed at 3 times the speed of the official client') with no harness, numbers, methodology or named version; directional only.

corrections.caveats: No benchmark exists; the 3x line comes from the SlackBuilds 14.1 README (libtorrent 0.13.6) and is absent from the current README. Technique: write() from mmap'ed chunks with madvise preload; encrypted peers bypass it; SIGBUS on full disk or truncated files (#825, #645). Needs C++20; no uTP or BEP52 v2; BitTorrent engine, weak fit for event-loops-io.

tier_reason: The README's 2.56x splices results from two different harnesses (llparse-test-fixture with SSE4.2 and no-op callbacks for llhttp vs bench.c in loose mode with an incomplete request and per-iteration reinit for http_parser), measured at different versions, so no like-for-like number exists. Directional only.

corrections.caveats: README table mixes harnesses and runs: llhttp 'ops/sec' from llparse-test-fixture (-msse4.2, direct no-op callbacks, complete message, re-measured at v2.0.0) vs http_parser 'req/sec' from bench.c (-O3, loose mode, function-pointer callbacks, missing final CRLF, reinit per iteration, unchanged since v1.0.1); no CPU, compiler or flags. SSE4.2 span scan needs __SSE4_2__ (the Makefile -Os build omits it). Open request-smuggling reports #876/#877. llhttp is itself the spec's http-parsers baseline.

tier_reason: The 2019 ab numbers come from an nginx baseline configured as shown in a README conf that cannot load (no events block) with the access log on and default keepalive_requests, driven by single-threaded ab, with no compiler, flags or CPU and no bench target; the author disclaims superiority (crippled-baseline precedent). Directional only.

corrections.caveats: README ab runs (2019-12-12, never re-run after the restructure): 1.66x keep-alive and 1.75x close vs nginx 1.14.0 with access log on, default keepalive_requests and a conf that does not load as shown; ab single-threaded; no compiler, flags or CPU. Library: header lines over 1024 bytes counted twice in _grwprintf (heap over-write), keep-alive token offsets never reset (#72), pipelining dropped, Content-Length overflow #77; needs -DEPOLL or -DKQUEUE.
